review_description: I cannot speak highly enough of Gavin the owner and installer.  I had many quotes and procrastinated for some time but Gavin was the only one that got on my roof to do measurements etc. This job also included removing and disposing of our old 3kw system.  He checked the entire sight for safety and gave me a complete run down of what was required for my 28 Panels and Sungrow Inverter.  This was not an easy roof to work on and I wanted the Inverter in a fairly awkward spot but nothing was too hard. I was given a complete rundown of the operation and best of all its hassle free with no input from me other than finding the best power provider.  The best part was that he lived 5 minutes away and this reassured me that he would easily come back if needed.  Everything went without a hitch and I now have my own mini power plant saving money and reaping the benefits.  Thanks Gavin for doing this job.  Money well spent adding much value to my home and I have now found a new electrician for all those other jobs I will eventually need doing.  The whole procedure using Solar Quotes was an absolute pleasure and the best decision.

Only person who actually got up on the roof and checked things out and then quoted based on what would best suit our house. Gav personally dealt with the whole job from quote to install to after service. Nothing was too much and I feel I have a quality system that was installed to the highest standard. Would thoroughly recommend.

Awesome from start to finish. Prompt onsite inspection and quote. Was the only company to actually get on the roof to check and measure. Never pushy trying to get me to sign up. Understanding of of buget restraints by offering other options. Fast and tidy installation with the inverter installed in the garage. Came back when I got home from work to setup and explain the inverter. Overall excellent service and would highly recommend!

I obtained three quotes, however, the quote from Ozmak Electrical was the most informative being highlighted with 2 options that maximised performance, with corresponding expected performance graphs.  The quote was very competitive and I decided to commission that company.  I made the right decision, the system was installed without a hitch, Gavin (the business owner and installer) from Ozmak was informative, his work extremely tidy, and nothing seemed to be a problem.  He obviously takes the utmost pride in his work evident by the high quality of his workmanship. My roof profile was problematic due to its shape, Gavin solved it with an aesthetic and efficient panel placement.  During the install he renewed some aging components in my switchboard, replaced a couple of dodgy roof tiles and even cut down a couple of trees that were shading some of the panels!  After the install he gave me a complete run down on the system and did not leave until I was satisfied regarding the install.  I thoroughly recommend Ozmak, if you are looking for old fashioned personalised service and a quality install at a cost effective price, do not go past this installer.
